steps: Peel and dice Sweet potato into 1 cm cubes; peel and slice Carrot (cooked); dice Onion; mince Garlic.
Heat Olive oil in a large pot over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add Onion and Garlic; cook for 3 minutes, stirring, until softened.
Stir in Turmeric and Ground ginger; cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add Sweet potato, Carrot (cooked), Cooked lentils, Coconut milk, and Unsalted vegetable broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes until sweet potato is very tender.
Nestle Salmon pieces into the simmering soup; cook for 6 to 8 minutes until salmon flakes easily.
Remove Salmon, flake into chunks discarding any bones, then return to the pot.
Stir in Lemon juice and ladle into bowls; blend partially for younger babies if needed.
Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 days or freeze for up to 1 month.
